mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate, indicative of an accommodative monetary policy stance, reduces the risk-free rate and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in household demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of supply contraction (INDPRO below 100), manufacturing output decline reduces corporate profit margins and future earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 12800 billion dollars signals a deepening economic contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 falls below 12800.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL above 215) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.25%) signal a potential shift to a hawkish monetary policy stance, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 215 and FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a monetary policy easing cycle (FEDFUNDS at or below 0.25%), the Federal Reserve's commitment to low rates supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.25%.
